args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks (error rate 0.18, unhealthy) in all production regions after deploying v2.3.1. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback status: rolled_out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing (error rate 0.18, `healthy: false`). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback reported `rolled_out` status.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback and noting root-cause investigation is pending.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, `healthy: true`, error rate 0.002.

Note: The rollback to v2.3.0 was a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
